def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines = [i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] != bg]
    col_lines = [j for j in range(w) if Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] != bg]
    line_color = Counter(grid[i][j] for i in row_lines for j in range(w)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for ra, rb in zip(row_lines, row_lines[1:]):
        row=[]
        for ca, cb in zip(col_lines, col_lines[1:]):
            corners = [grid[ra][ca], grid[ra][cb], grid[rb][ca], grid[rb][cb]]
            marker = corners[0]
            row.append(marker if marker != line_color and all(v == marker for v in corners) else bg)
        out.append(row)
    active_rows=[i for i,row in enumerate(out) if any(v != bg for v in row)]
    active_cols=[j for j in range(len(out[0])) if any(out[i][j] != bg for i in range(len(out)))]
    if not active_rows or not active_cols:
        return out
    return [row[min(active_cols):max(active_cols)+1] for row in out[min(active_rows):max(active_rows)+1]]

program_source = '''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
                 if Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] != background]
    col_lines = [j for j in range(w)
                 if Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] != background]
    line_color = Counter(grid[i][j] for i in row_lines for j in range(w)).most_common(1)[0][0]

    output = []
    for top, bottom in zip(row_lines, row_lines[1:]):
        row = []
        for left, right in zip(col_lines, col_lines[1:]):
            corners = [grid[top][left], grid[top][right],
                       grid[bottom][left], grid[bottom][right]]
            marker = corners[0]
            row.append(marker if marker != line_color and all(v == marker for v in corners)
                       else background)
        output.append(row)

    active_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(output) if any(v != background for v in row)]
    active_cols = [j for j in range(len(output[0]))
                   if any(output[i][j] != background for i in range(len(output)))]
    if not active_rows or not active_cols:
        return output
    return [row[min(active_cols):max(active_cols) + 1]
            for row in output[min(active_rows):max(active_rows) + 1]]
'''
